title: Data-Oriented Design Integration Layer (DODIL): A Powerful Augmented Schema Framework for LLM-Powered Systems
content: Large Language Models (LLMs) have emerged as powerful tools for natural language understanding and human-AI interaction. While LLMs excel at generating insights and responding to user queries, significant challenges arise when they are tasked with interacting with complex application data systems. Unlike basic database querying, real-world applications involve intricate architectures, non-standardized interfaces, and domain-specific semantics, making integration with LLMs a non-trivial task. This article highlights the key challenges faced by LLMs in effectively interfacing with modern application environments.
